params.name: event_name
params.description: It is the conversion event name. Nextdoor documents a fixed lowercase set.
params.fix_hint: Set `event_name` to a documented value such as `purchase` or `page_view`.

params.name: action_source
params.description: It names the channel the conversion happened on.
params.fix_hint: Set `action_source` to a documented channel such as `website`.

params.name: event_id
params.description: It identifies the event so Pixel and CAPI can deduplicate.
params.fix_hint: Set `event_id` to the same deterministic id the Pixel sent.

params.name: event_time_epoch
params.description: It is Unix time in seconds. Nextdoor documents no milliseconds. `event_time` is deprecated.
params.fix_hint: Send `event_time_epoch` as a 10-digit Unix timestamp in seconds.

params.name: data_source_id
params.description: It is the Pixel ID. Nextdoor documents `data_source_id` and deprecated `pixel_id`.
params.fix_hint: Set `data_source_id` to the Pixel ID from Nextdoor Ads.

params.name: customer
params.description: It holds matching identifiers. Nextdoor documents it as required.
params.fix_hint: Send a `customer` object with at least one of hashed `email`, hashed `phone_number`, or `click_id`.

params.name: action_source_url
params.description: It is the page URL. Nextdoor documents it as required for website events.
params.fix_hint: Set `action_source_url` to the absolute page URL.

params.name: customer.email
params.description: It is the SHA-256 digest of the email after trim and lowercase.
params.fix_hint: Trim, lowercase, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: customer.phone_number
params.description: It is the SHA-256 digest of the phone number.
params.fix_hint: Hash the ten-digit phone and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: customer.click_id
params.description: It is the `ndclid` from the Nextdoor click URL.

params.name: customer.client_user_agent
params.description: It is the raw browser user agent. Nextdoor documents it as required for website events, and not hashed.

params.name: customer.client_ip_address
params.description: It is the browser IP, IPv4 or IPv6, sent unhashed.

params.name: customer.first_name
params.description: It is the SHA-256 digest of the first name after lowercase.
params.fix_hint: Lowercase, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: customer.last_name
params.description: It is the SHA-256 digest of the last name after lowercase.
params.fix_hint: Lowercase, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: customer.date_of_birth
params.description: It is the SHA-256 digest of the date of birth. Nextdoor documents YYYYMMDD before hashing.
params.fix_hint: Format as YYYYMMDD, SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: customer.street_address
params.description: It is the SHA-256 digest of the street address.

params.name: customer.city
params.description: It is the SHA-256 digest of the city after lowercase with no spaces.

params.name: customer.state
params.description: It is the SHA-256 digest of the two-letter ANSI state code after lowercase.

params.name: customer.zip_code
params.description: It is the SHA-256 digest of the ZIP code. Nextdoor documents the first 5 digits for US codes before hashing.

params.name: customer.country
params.description: It is the SHA-256 digest of the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code after lowercase.

params.name: customer.gender
params.description: It is the SHA-256 digest of `f`, `m`, or `n`. Nextdoor documents the initial as hashed.
params.fix_hint: Hash `f`, `m`, or `n` with SHA-256 and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: customer.external_id
params.description: It is the advertiser's own user id, such as a loyalty id.

params.name: custom.order_id
params.description: It is the order ID for the transaction. Nextdoor documents it as required for offline events.

params.name: custom.order_value
params.description: It is ISO 4217 currency then the amount, such as `USD49.99`. Nextdoor documents it as required on purchase.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom.order_value` to a currency code followed by the amount, such as `USD49.99`.

params.name: custom.delivery_category
params.description: It names how the purchase was fulfilled. Nextdoor documents `in_store`, `curbside`, and `home_delivery`.

params.name: custom.product_context[].id
params.description: It is the product id on a `product_context` row. Nextdoor documents `id` on each product object.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom.product_context[].id` to the SKU or catalog id, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom.product_context[].content_name
params.description: It is the product name on a `product_context` row. Nextdoor lists `content_name` with `id`, `quantity`, and `item_price`.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom.product_context[].content_name` to the product name, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom.product_context[].quantity
params.description: It is the quantity of that product. Nextdoor documents `quantity` as an integer on each product object.
params.fix_hint: Send `custom.product_context[].quantity` as a whole number, such as `2`.

params.name: custom.product_context[].item_price
params.description: It is the unit price of that product. The conversions/track example uses a decimal such as `5.99`. It is not a replacement for `custom.order_value`.
params.fix_hint: Send `custom.product_context[].item_price` as a number, such as `5.99`. Put the order total in `custom.order_value`.

params.name: app.app_id
params.description: It is the App Store or Google Play app id. Nextdoor documents the `app` object as required for app events.
params.fix_hint: Set `app.app_id` to the store app id.

params.name: app.platform
params.description: It is the mobile platform. Nextdoor documents `iOS` and `Android`.
params.fix_hint: Set `app.platform` to `iOS` or `Android`.

params.name: app.app_version
params.description: It is the mobile app version string.

params.name: app.app_tracking_enabled
params.description: It is the ATT opt-in flag. Nextdoor documents a boolean.
params.fix_hint: Send `app.app_tracking_enabled` as `true` or `false`.

params.name: restricted_data_usage
params.description: When set, Nextdoor documents `1` (or `true`) to keep the event for reporting only.
params.fix_hint: Send `restricted_data_usage` as an integer, such as `1`.

params.name: restricted_data_usage_country
params.description: It associates a country with Limited Data Use. Nextdoor documents `1` for the United States.
params.fix_hint: Set `restricted_data_usage_country` to `1`.

params.name: restricted_data_usage_state
params.description: It associates a US state with Limited Data Use. Nextdoor documents codes `1000` (California) through `1018` (Rhode Island).
params.fix_hint: Set `restricted_data_usage_state` to a documented code such as `1000` for California.

params.name: delivery_optimization
params.description: True means the event may be used for optimization. False means attribution only.
params.fix_hint: Send `delivery_optimization` as `true` or `false`.

params.name: event_timezone
params.description: It is an optional timezone for where the conversion took place.

params.name: partner_id
params.description: It names the integration vendor or agency partner. Nextdoor documents it as reference, not attribution.

params.name: test_event
params.description: It flags a test conversion. Nextdoor documents a string such as `TEST1234`.

rules.message: `customer` carries none of the match keys Nextdoor requires. Send hashed `email`, hashed `phone_number`, or `click_id`.
rules.fix_hint: Add at least one of hashed email, hashed phone, or `ndclid`.

rules.message: The event is `action_source: website` but carries no `action_source_url`. Nextdoor documents the page URL as required for website events.
rules.fix_hint: Set `action_source_url` to the absolute page URL.

rules.message: The event is `action_source: website` but carries no `customer.client_user_agent`. Nextdoor documents the user agent as required for website CAPI events.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw browser user agent in `customer.client_user_agent`.

rules.message: The event is `purchase` but carries no `custom.order_value`. Nextdoor documents order value as required on purchase.
rules.fix_hint: Set `custom.order_value` to a currency code followed by the amount, such as `USD49.99`.

rules.message: The event is `action_source: app` but carries no `app.app_id`. Nextdoor documents the `app` object as required for app events.
rules.fix_hint: Set `app.app_id` to the App Store or Google Play app id.

rules.message: `customer.email` carries what looks like a raw email address. Nextdoor documents SHA-256 after trim and lowercase.
rules.fix_hint: Trim, lowercase, hash with SHA-256, and send the 64-character hex digest.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Nextdoor documents `client_ip_address` and `client_user_agent` as unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address or user agent.
